name: MailCue Self-Hosted Email Testing Server
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted email testing stack with SMTP capture, IMAP/POP3, web UI, REST API, DKIM/DMARC checks and spam filtering; no vendor-enforced usage quota or expiry for the self-managed software.
watch_out: Self-hosted software only: provide and pay for your own Docker host, storage, network, DNS and email infrastructure. Default demo credentials must be changed; production mode can send real email and requires security hardening. No free hosted email delivery, compute or storage is included.
